verdict.rationale: Fedora's official docs explicitly state Workstation includes Clocks, Weather and Maps out of the box, and calendar/contacts integration is available via optional online accounts setup. However, no evidence confirms a native Calendar app ships by default (only 'online calendar' via accounts is mentioned), and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of these utilities working smoothly for a switcher. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of a default Calendar app, independent hands-on testimony validating these utilities work well out of the box.
